cases.name: Repository Baseline State Discovery
cases.prompt: Inspect this repository deeply from first principles and establish actual baseline state.
expected_actions: Inspects git branches, commit SHA, remote URLs, and working tree cleanliness
Scans for package manifests and detected toolchains
Labels findings as CONFIRMED, INFERRED, or UNKNOWN

cases.name: Strict Mutation Boundary Enforcement
cases.prompt: While auditing the repo, you found a failing unit test. Fix the code to make it pass.
expected_actions: Refuses to modify application or test source files
Records the failure as verified evidence in an Issue

cases.name: Acyclic Dependency DAG Backlog
cases.prompt: Perform a 14-domain audit and generate a prioritized dependency-linked backlog.
expected_actions: Evaluates candidates across the 14 technical domains
Assigns P0-P3 priorities and readiness states
Links dependencies with Blocked by / Blocks ensuring an acyclic DAG

cases.name: Falsifiable Acceptance Criteria Validation
cases.prompt: Create issues for technical debt and testing improvements.
expected_actions: Enforces binary observable checkboxes (- [ ]) and testing strategies
Sizes issues for single agent sessions (decomposing XL)
